title: Setting a manual temp-target is not working
body:
Hello
I noticed that whenever I try to set a user defined (manual) temp-target, I just get the question if I want to abort the existing temp-target even though there is none active. Therefore I am unable to set such a temp-target.
When I use the quick-buttons (eating-soon, hypo, etc.) then it works as expected. 

I am using AAPS v2.8.2, a Google Pixel 4a and a DanaRS-Pump in open-loop-mode (objective 5).

I attached a video showing the problem. 
You can see that there is no temp-target active in the beginning. I tried to set it to 120 mg/dl via the target-button on the main screen and via the temp-target-button in the actions tab but both ways fail. At the end of the video I use a pre-defined quick-button and the temp-target works.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52973190/108067214-c1787380-7060-11eb-95e1-5583cbfa770b.mp4

comments.body:
Well, I see my my mistake, I didn't enter an length for the TT.

But maybe it would be better, to give a more clear error message in this case.
